notes.title: Cleaning Queens - Coming soon on Steam
notes.content:
Hi gaming people! 

We are proud & excited to announce this great news! 
Cleaning Queens is our freshest and polished game that came from our studio and is soon to be released on the Steam platform, that's clear (and soon to be clean!). 

What can you expect? 
A whole lot of cleaning actions, a bunch of tools to help you with that, and on top of that - renovation!

All you need for this cleaning is a comfy chair - sit back and relax, and things are going to become much better! 

Don't forget to add Cleaning Queens to your wishlist, more surprises waiting for you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2229420/Cleaning_Queens/
